# @open-xchange/bootstrap-datepicker

> 标签: datepicker, twitter-bootstrap

## 简介

A datepicker for twitter bootstrap forked from eternicode which is a fork of Stefan Petre's (of eyecon.ro) fork

- 官网：https://github.com/Open-Xchange-Frontend/bootstrap-datepicker
